annotation.interpretation_a: The proxy appends its own domain to the host name, e.g., "example" becomes "example.proxy.com".
annotation.interpretation_b: The proxy prepends its own domain to the host name, e.g., "example" becomes "proxy.com.example".
annotation.justification: The clause does not specify whether the proxy’s domain should be appended or prepended to the host name, allowing two materially different implementation behaviours.
